# A carrier within 30 minutes of its window keeps its slot

## Rule Statement

A truck arriving up to 30 minutes after the start of its appointment window is worked in that window. Past 30 minutes the slot goes back to the grid and the carrier takes whatever is left that day.

## Enforcement

required

## Rationale

Terry Blake's position at the February workshop was that a grace period is whatever the gate actually honours, so the number has to be short enough that the door behind it turns over. An hour of grace makes every slot an hour long and the grid stops meaning anything by mid-morning.

## Known Exceptions

None granted. Iris Vogel asked about the LTL shuttle and Terry declined: the shuttle runs on reserved doors and never competes for a graded slot.
